query:
SELECT DISTINCT
             CASE WHEN a.shared_inbox_url IS NOT NULL AND a.shared_inbox_url <> ''
                  THEN a.shared_inbox_url
                  ELSE a.inbox_url
             END AS inbox
           FROM mentions m
           JOIN accounts a ON a.id = m.account_id
           WHERE m.status_id = $1
             AND a.domain IS NOT NULL
             AND a.inbox_url <> ''
